Selangor Fire and Rescue Department director Datuk Norazam Khamis said at the initial stage, the team would dig or remove the soil three or four feet deep to facilitate the detection of the victims’ bodies. “After that, the team will stop digging and conduct checks, either through the K9 tracker dog unit or manually, to see if there is any sign of human remains. “If there is no sign, we will continue the digging process slowly to prevent the (excavator) bucket from damaging any bodies,” he told a press conference here today. Norazam said the process was also monitored by a member of the rescue team who would give guidance and instructions on how to excavate. “We don’t want them (excavation team) to dig the soil as they do for land clearing works. It should be done slowly and lightly,” he said. As of this morning, eight excavators were deployed to ground zero, and the number will be increased if the need arises. Norazam further said that the rescue team also received the Ground Penetrating Radars from the Department of Survey and Mapping and the National Disaster Management Agency (NADMA) to assist in efforts to locate the remaining victims. “The two teams using these devices have been deployed to sector A (Hillview) and sector C (Riverside) to detect the locations of the victims and measure the thickness of the soil,” he said. A resident, Razni Samsuddin, 64, said the relevant authorities should do a technical study of the area and implement slope stabilisation work quickly so that the affected residents can return to their homes. “I leave it to the relevant bodies which handle the technical aspects to do what is necessary to prevent a recurrrence in the future,” he told Bernama yesterday. Recalling the incident, Razni said it happend at about 8.30 pm when soil from the slope began entering the area of his home. Another resident, Ajmal Zaim, 25, said he hoped the additional pilings and cement work could be done to prevent a repeat of what happened. “This will prevent soil or earth from entering the river each time there is a downpour,” he said. For Puziah Ahmad, 68, she was waiting for further instructions from the authorities on whether she should move out. She said she would abide if asked to vacate her home but till now there have been no instructions from the authorities for her to move out. Meanwhile, Ampang Jaya district police chief Mohamad Farouk said security or 24-hour “checkpoints” have been activated at the entry-exit to Jalan Tujuh and Kemensah Indah here. “To date, there have been no reports of break-ins or theft of properties and affected residents are allowed to be in their homes until six in the evening every day to manage their homes,” said Farouk when contacted by Bernama. Bernama also visited the scene of the landslide today and found that cleaning and slope stabilisation work was being carried out by the Selangor Drainage and Irrigation Department (DID). Tanah runtuh di blok asrama UIAM, pelajar diarah pindah – Bomba

Oleh Haslina AR Kamaludin -   27 December 2021 







The landslide at the male students dormitory at the International Islamic University Malaysia (IIUM) in Gombak.
Keadaan kwasan tanah runtuh di asrama lelaki UIAM.

KUALA LUMPUR – Seramai 128 penghuni asrama lelaki Universiti Islam Antabangsa Malaysia (UIAM) di Gombak agar mengosongkan kediaman tersebut selepas kejadian tanah runtuh semalam.
Pengarah Jabatan Bomba dan Penyelamat Malaysia (JBPM) Selangor, Norazam Khamis berkata, pengosongan itu perlu dilakukan segera hasil tinjauan dan pemantauan yang dilakukan.

“Biarpun tiada kesan rekahan baharu pada dinding atau lantai, namun demi keselamatan, kesemua mereka harus dikeluarkan segera.
“Ia tidak selamat diduduki dan diarahkan kosong sehingga laporan struktur tanah dan pengukuhan tanah selesai,” katanya dalam satu kenyataan hari ini.
Tinjauan mendapan tanah yang dilakukan oleh JBPM dan Ikram di asrama lelaki UIAM Gombak hari ini.
Beliau berkata, kajian lanjut akan dibuat oleh pihak berkuasa yang berkaitan.
Terdahulu, tinjauan mendapan tanah ini dibuat bersama-sama pihak UIA dan juga Institut Kerja Raya Malaysia (Ikram) selepas berlaku tanah runtuh dan mendapan jalan di kawasan bangunan tersebut sejak semalam. -MalaysiaGazette

Tanah runtuh di blok asrama UIAM, pelajar diarah pindah – Bomba

By Haslina AR Kamaludin -   27 December 2021 



The landslide at the male students dormitory at the International Islamic University Malaysia (IIUM) in Gombak.
Keadaan kwasan tanah runtuh di asrama lelaki UIAM.
KUALA LUMPUR – Seramai 128 penghuni asrama lelaki Universiti Islam Antabangsa Malaysia (UIAM) di Gombak agar mengosongkan kediaman tersebut selepas kejadian tanah runtuh semalam.
Pengarah Jabatan Bomba dan Penyelamat Malaysia (JBPM) Selangor, Norazam Khamis berkata, pengosongan itu perlu dilakukan segera hasil tinjauan dan pemantauan yang dilakukan.

“Biarpun tiada kesan rekahan baharu pada dinding atau lantai, namun demi keselamatan, kesemua mereka harus dikeluarkan segera.
“Ia tidak selamat diduduki dan diarahkan kosong sehingga laporan struktur tanah dan pengukuhan tanah selesai,” katanya dalam satu kenyataan hari ini.
Tinjauan mendapan tanah yang dilakukan oleh JBPM dan Ikram di asrama lelaki UIAM Gombak hari ini.
Beliau berkata, kajian lanjut akan dibuat oleh pihak berkuasa yang berkaitan.
Terdahulu, tinjauan mendapan tanah ini dibuat bersama-sama pihak UIA dan juga Institut Kerja Raya Malaysia (Ikram) selepas berlaku tanah runtuh dan mendapan jalan di kawasan bangunan tersebut sejak semalam. -MalaysiaGazette

Leakages in water piping system at MACA landslide location: Nanta                                                                                                    Home       Local       World       Business       Sport       Motoring       Lifestyle       Opinion       Images       Classified       Education        More          Going Viral       Spotlight       Berita       Advertise with us       Jobs                          Home       Local       World       Business       Sport       Motoring       Lifestyle       Opinion       Images       Classified       Education        More          Going Viral       Spotlight       Berita       Advertise with us       Jobs                                            Log In                               Log In                                               Home       Local       World       Business       Sport       Motoring       Lifestyle       Opinion       Images       Classified       Education        More          Going Viral       Spotlight       Berita       Advertise with us       Jobs                                     Local        Leakages in water piping system at MACA landslide location: Nanta               26-04- 2023 05:00 PM           BERNAMAPIX        KUALA LUMPUR: The Public Works Department (JKR) found leakages in the water piping system at the location of the landslide that occurred at the main entrance of the Malaysian Anti-Corruption Academy (MACA) at Persiaran Tunku Syed Sirajuddin, Bukit Tunku yesterday. Works Minister Datuk Seri Alexander Nanta Linggi said this was discovered by JKR’s Slope Engineering Branch’s Landslide Forensic Division during preliminary investigations on the incident. He said pipe leakages led to the soil being fully saturated, further increasing the lateral force on the contiguous micropile retaining wall. “Part of the retaining wall collapsed along with the slope,” he said in a post on Facebook today. Nanta said rainfall at Sentul Station from April 21 to April 24 also recorded high readings ranging from 16.0 millimeters (mm) to 47.5 mm, adding that during the incident, the weather was good with no rain at all. He said JKR also required the as-built drawing of the existing retaining wall structure from the building owner for further checks on the retaining wall structure. Nanta also said that site clearing works at the main entrance of MACA at Persiaran Tuanku Syed Sirajuddin here will begin this afternoon through an appointed contractor Also to begin this afternoon is the installation of tarpaulin sheets in the collapsed area to prevent rainwater from seeping directly into the ground. “Works to install tilt sensors to monitor ground movement is expected to take place from April 27,” Nanta said. Bernama reported yesterday that MACA has emptied its entire premises and transferred 45 people after a landslide occurred at its main entrance at around 1.30 pm yesterday. The Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC) said 22 officers, 16 cleaning crew and seven quarters residents, including families of officers, were moved to a safe area. - Bernama                                                                            Dream come true as brothers get their own homes                        Mooryati Soedibyo, founder of Mustika Ratu cosmetics, dies at 96                        Media practitioner files police report against X account user over comments on copter tragedy                        Mendiang Sivasutan anak yang sangat baik, tidak tolak permintaan orang tua - Bapa                        Permohonan pekebun Musang King cabar notis kosongkan tanah ditolak            Recommended stories                                                                         SUGGESTED STORIES                   Steps to Access Subsidised Diesel for Transportation Vehicles                       BYD Unveils Official Interior of the Sea Lion 07                       Dream come true as brothers get their own homes                           Mooryati Soedibyo, founder of Mustika Ratu cosmetics, dies at 96                       Mendiang Sivasutan anak yang sangat baik, tidak tolak permintaan orang tua - Bapa                       Media practitioner files police report against X account user over comments on copter tragedy            ×                       TODAY NEWS        1.FORGOTTEN BABY SYNDROME           2.VIN LAW CO. One of the residents, Yusof Angah, 42, said that he became aware of the incident when he was on his way to take his two children from his home in Kampung Hanir to Sekolah Kebangsaan Pos Hendrop, at about 6.45 this morning. He said that the landslide incident had occurred in the middle of the route to and from the village. “The location of the incident is far from the village, so we did not hear any noise last night. I had to turn back, as the road was completely impassable for vehicles including motorcycles. “I also alerted residents of Kampung Hanir, Kampung Gere, Kampung Perlug and Kampung Tuel about the incident on my way home as a precautionary measure,” he said, when contacted today. Another resident, Zakaria Pinang, 48, who also passed through the route, was thankful that the incident did not cause any casualties. “It is unimaginable if the landslide occurred as we were passing through to take children to school,” he said. Kampung Hanir penghulu, Razak Rongging, 41, said that the continuous rain since last week is believed to be one of the causes of the landslide, therefore he hopes that the authorities will repair the road immediately. According to him, following the incident, about 500 residents were affected in doing their daily activities, while hawkers could not enter their settlements. Meanwhile, the Kelantan and Terengganu Orang Asli Development Department director, Zarina Razlan, when contacted, said that such incidents usually occur, as the hillside is a waterway. “We advise residents to be more careful, especially during the Northeast Monsoon season,” she said. - Bernama                                                                                     Naza Group completes acquisition of Berjaya Enviro, becomes key player in waste management                         Rakyat perlu kuasai AI untuk tentukan sendiri nilai moral, budaya dalam teknologi itu - PM                        Isu perumahan lima ladang di Bestari Jaya, kerajaan bakal umum berita baik - Nga                        KKB Polls: NGA ready to cooperate with EC over allocation announcement                        NGA: Govt to announce good news on housing issue involving five estates in Bestari Jaya            Recommended stories                                                                         SUGGESTED STORIES                   Naza Group completes acquisition of Berjaya Enviro, becomes key player in waste management    6 Hours

Orang Asli Village Security Development Committee (JPKKOA) secretary Aman Pak Ngah said after the incident, villagers could no longer go to the Gua Musang town to carry out their daily affairs or purchase necessities. “Before this, we could access the road using motorcycles, but we have been standed here since Friday after continuous heavy rain resulted in a landslide about 100 metres from Kampung Gawin. “In fact, a 4WD team who tried to enter this village to send food supplies using motorcycles had to turn back,” he told reporters here today. Public Works Minister Datuk Seri Alexander Nanta Linggi in a statement today said his ministry through the Public Works Department (JKR) in collaboration with relevant government agencies, is preparing the final draft report. “I understand that many parties, including the families of the affected victims, want to know or get the final report of the incident, therefore I assure JKR is doing its best to complete this process,“ he said. Nanta said among the elements that were taken into account in the completion of the report were soil investigation tests in the field and laboratory as well as data analysis. “It is important that data from this test is analysed to determine the failure mechanism by various experts including from the aspects of geology and geotechnical engineering,“ he said. Yesterday, the media reported that victims of the Batang Kali landslide tragedy demanded that the government issue a full investigation report on the tragedy. The tragedy on Dec 16, 2022 at about 2.30 in the morning, involved 92 victims, with 61 of them surviving while 31 dead, after a landslide buried the Father’s Organic Farm camping area in Batang Kali. Ampang landslide kills 4, SAR ends

Oleh Admin -   11 March 2022 







The search and rescue team with the family members of the last victim who was killed in the Taman Bukit Permai 2 landslide in Ampang, Kuala Lumpur.
PIX: MUHD NA'IM / MalaysiaGazette / 11 MARCH 2022.
Waris korban keempat iaitu korban terakhir dipercayai lelaki berbangsa india mangsa tertimbus dalam kejadian tanah runtuh ketika tinjuan Malaysia Gazette di Taman Bukit Permai2 Ampang, Kuala Lumpur. Foto MUHD NA'IM, 11 MAC 2022

KUALA LUMPUR: The bodies of the third and fourth victims of the landslide at Taman Bukit Permai 2 in Ampang, here, were found early this morning.
Earlier yesterday, the body of an elderly woman was brought out at 9.15 pm and that of a man was discovered at about 11 pm while another man, who was injured, was rescued from the rubble.

Ampang Jaya District Police chief ACP Mohamad Farouk Eshak said the two victims, whose bodies were found early today, were Malaysians and one of them was an employee of Syarikat Pengurusan Air Selangor Sdn Bhd.
He said the third body was found at 12.46 am while the fourth was found at 1.59 am, adding that the identities of all the dead victims have yet to be ascertained.
“As such, the search and rescue (SAR) operation ended early this morning,” he told a media conference at the site of the incident.
He said police would conduct a 24-hour security control of the area to ensure that the belongings of the affected residents are not looted and the houses are not broken into.
Mohamad Farouk urged residents whose homes are broken into to lodge a police report.
Meanwhile, Selangor Fire and Rescue Department director Norazam Khamis said they would use the K-9 Unit tracker dogs at the site of the landslide to ensure there are no other victims involved.
“Clean-up work at the site will be carried out by the Ampang Jaya Municipal Council,” he said.
A Bernama survey of the area found a number of SAR team members from the police and Civil Defence Force beginning to disperse from the location following the discovery of all four bodies.
Meanwhile, the Ministry of Health was also seen packing up its special treatment tents following the end of the SAR operation by police at about 2 am. – Bernama

Victim cautioned others on landslides in Cameron Highlands

Oleh Admin -   3 December 2021 







Tugas anggota bomba penuh berisiko di lapangan.

IPOH: The lorry driver who was killed in the landslide at KM27.10 Jalan Simpang Pulai-Blue Valley here, had always shared stories of landslides in Cameron Highlands to raise the awareness of others but little did he know that he would be a victim himself.
The victim, Muhammad Hafiz Hamdi, 31, a father of two, aged two and an infant, had been transporting vegetables from the highlands daily.

The elder brother of the victim, Mohd Kamal Hamdi, 40, said he was surprised when his younger brother was quiet when he shared the landslide story on their family WhatsApp site.
“I felt strange as he did not respond and so I contacted his friends to check on his whereabouts.
“When his colleague told me that my brother was involved in the incident, I returned to Ipoh straight away by driving from Kuala Lumpur and dashed to the landslide location as I could not believe it could happen to him,” he said when met by reporters at the incident location on Thursday (Dec 2).
Mohd Kamal said the identification of the body was carried out by his wife, who was traumatised by the event.
According to him, the body would be laid to rest in their village in Tanjung Piandang, Parit Buntar after all processes at Raja Permaisuri Bainun Hospital (HRPB), Ipoh have been completed.
Meanwhile, at HRPB Forensic Department, the victim’s brother-in-law when met said the victim was a cheerful and good man.
Rosli Saidin, 52, from Butterworth, Penang said he knew of the incident at about 7pm from the victim’s wife who is his younger sister.
“My children saw the picture of the incident which went viral but could not confirm if it was my brother-in-law.
“Our entire family has accepted the shocking turn of events,” he said.
Rosli, who is also a vegetable lorry driver, said his brother-in-law had been carrying vegetables from Cameron Highlands for sale in Parit Buntar everyday.
He said the victim and his sister were married four years ago and added the victim’s wife rushed from Tanjung Piandang to the incident location on receiving the bad news.
So far, two victims buried in the landslide were found dead, namely Muhammad Hafz and the driver of a luxury multi-purpose vehicle identified as Tan Chee Heng, 36, who was on his way from Gua Musang to Penang.
It was learned that Tan, who was from Klang, Selangor wanted to visit his grandmother and was bringing strawberries in the vehicle he was driving. – Bernama

Cameron Highlands landslide: Identity of victim identified

Oleh Admin -   2 December 2021 







Two vehicles are believed to be burried in the landslide at Section 27 FT 185 Jalan Simpang Pulai-Blue Valley (Cameron Highlands).
Dua kenderaan dipercayai terperangkap dalam timbunan tanah runtuh ini.

By Malinda Abdul Malik
IPOH – The identity of the vegetables lorry driver who was trapped in the landslide at Section 27 FT 185 Jalan Simpang Pulai-Blue Valley (Cameron Highlands) this evening has been identified.

The effort to excavate the victim, Muhammad Hafiz Hamdi, 31, is ongoing by the Fire and Rescue Department.
The Perak District Police Chief, Datuk Mior Faridalathrash Wahid said that early investigation found that the lorry driver was on his way from Cameron Highlands to Ipoh carrying vegetables.
Effort to excavate the victims is ongoing by the Fire and Rescue Department.Usaha mengesan dan mengeluarkan mangsa teperangkap giat dilakukan.
He said, the rescue team has detected the location of the lorry and is trying to rescue the victim is buried in the landslide.
“However, we do not know the condition of the victim and efforts to rescue him is being carried out by the Fire and Rescue team,” he told the media today.
According to Mior Faridalathrash, the rescue team is using two excavators to dig out the earth at the location.
“The Cameron Highlands Department of Works (JKR) is also assisting in this rescue,” he said.
Meanwhile, the spokesperson from the Perak Fire and Rescue Department said that they received a distress call on the incident at 1.44 pm and the Simpang Pulai Fire and Rescue team was rushed to the location for the rescue operation.
“Based on preliminary information, a lorry and a Toyota Vellfire multi-purpose vehicle (MPV) were trapped in the landslide.
“We have not identified the number of victims involved at the moment. The incident also caused the main route to Cameron Highlands from both ways to be closed to all vehicles,” he said. -MalaysiaGazette

The victim, Muhammad Hafiz Hamdi, 31, a father of two, aged two and an infant had been transporting vegetables from the highlands daily. The elder brother of the victim, Mohd Kamal Hamdi, 40, said he was surprised when his younger brother was quiet when he shared the landslide story on their family WhatsApp site. “I felt strange as he did not respond and so I contacted his friends to check on his whereabouts. “When his colleague told me that my brother was involved in the incident, I return to Ipoh straight away by driving from Kuala Lumpur and dashed to the landslide location as I could not believe it could happen to him,” he said when met by reporters at the incident location today. Mohd Kamal said the identification of the body was carried out by his wife was traumatized by the event. According to him, the body would be laid to rest in their village in Tanjung Piandang, Parit Buntar after all processes at Raja Permaisuri Bainun Hospital (HRPB), Ipoh have been completed. Meanwhile, at HRPB Forensic Department, the victim’s brother in law when met said the victim was a cheerful and good man. Rosli Saidin, 52, from Butterworth, Penang said he knew of the incident at about 7 pm from the victim’s wife who is his younger sister. “My children saw the picture of the incident which went viral but could not confirm if it was my brother in law. “Our entire family accepted the shocking turn of events,” he said. Rosli who is also a vegetable lorry driver said his brother-in-law had been carrying vegetables from Cameron Highlands for sale in Parit Buntar everyday. He said the victim and his sister were married four years ago and added the victim’s wife rushed from Tanjung Piandang to the incident location on receiving the bad news. So far two victims buried in the landslide were found dead, namely Muhammad Hafz and the driver of a Toyota Alphard identified as Tan Chee Heng, 36, who was on his way from Gua Musang to Penang. He said the rescue team was trying to pull open the cabin door of the lorry and was using a backhoe to clear the piles of earth and a drone to get an aerial view of soil movements. He said motorists should use an alternative route on Federal Road FT059 Tapah-Ringlet which was fully open to all vehicles from yesterday at 5pm to travel to Cameron Highlands. A Bernama check found the family members of the victim had also arrived at the location at about 7.30pm. No illegal logging around Lake Kenyir – MB

By Admin -   4 March 2022 



Datuk Seri Dr. Ahmad Samsuri Mokhtar
By Manzaidi Mohd Amin
KUALA LUMPUR – Heavy rain and debris flow were among the causes for the flood and landslides at the Sungai Terengganu area, near the Sultan Mahmud Hydroelectric Power Plant at Lake Kenyir last Sunday.

According to the Menteri Besar of Terengganu, Datuk Seri Dr. Ahmad Samsuri Mokhtar, the Terengganu Forestry Department has conducted an investigation on the incident.
The investigation concluded that there was no illegal logging activity at the area as alleged by certain quarters.
“They happened due to the five days of continuous rain from 23 until 27 February and reached 1,000 mililitres,” he said in a statement today.
Yesterday, the Terengganu State Forestry Department Director, Roslan Rani denied the illegal logging allegations around Lake Kenyir which caused the huge damage during flood last Sunday.
On the contrary, he said, based on the briefing by Tenaga Nasional Berhad (TNB), the situation was caused by landslides near the Sultan Mahmud Hydroelectric Power Plant at Kenyir.
He said, the debris flow also caused the trees nearby, garbage, dead branches to be flow into the river.
Elaborating further, Ahmad Samsuri said that the landslide was about 100 meters in length and 50 metres wide with the thickness between five to 10 metres.
The debris flow moved from the peak of the hill until Sungai Terengganu which reached up to 300 metres in length.
“A post-disaster coordination meeting was held and the cleaning works are ongoing.
“Aerial observation and patrols are carried out from time to time to monitor the situation,” he said. -MalaysiaGazette

Pas ‘all out’ pastikan Tok Mad pertahan kerusi DUN Rantau

Oleh admin -   30 March 2019 







Datuk Seri Dr. Ahmad Samsuri Mokhtar

SEREMBAN – Jentera PAS dari seluruh negara dikerahkan supaya turun berkempen untuk Datuk Seri Mohamad Hasan yang bertanding sebagai calon Barisan Nasional (BN) pada Pilihan Raya Kecil (PRK) Dewan Undangan Negeri (DUN) Rantau.
Pengarah Pilihan Raya Pas, Dr Ahmad Samsuri Moktar berkata, parti itu akan mengguna peranan Dewan Himpunan Penyokong Pas (DHPP) secara ‘all out’.

“Kerjasama erat antara UMNO dan Pas dan strategi khusus akan membantu Mohamad mampu mempertahankan kerusi tradisinya.
“Saya percaya DHPP juga telah merangka strategi untuk membantu berkempen di sini,” katanya kepada Harakahdaily.
Katanya, PAS juga telah mengeluarkan arahan mewajibkan semua pengundi PAS di Rantau mengundi calon BN.
Ahmad Samsuri yakin Mohamad yang mesra dipanggil Tok Mad layak mengekalkan kerusi di DUN Rantau berikutan pelbagai pembangunan yang telah dilakukan demi rakyat Dun Rantau.
Tambah Samsuri yang juga Menteri Besar Terengganu, rakyat Dun Rantau telah menyaksikan sendiri kepimpinan Mohamad dan seharusnya figura ini adalah layak menjadi wakil rakyat di sini.
PAS, katanya akan sentiasa komited membantu kempen secara matang dan sejahtera.
Beliau berharap Pakatan Harapan berkempen dengan sebaik-baiknya mengikut lunas demokrasi.
“Kita harap elakkan budaya fitnah-memfitnah dalam sebarang aktiviti sebagai memberi keharmonian yang lebih baik sepanjang kempen ini berlangsung,” ujarnya. – MalaysiaGazette

‘I am still the MB of Terengganu’ – Ahmad Samsuri

Oleh Admin -   10 June 2021 







Datuk Seri Dr. Ahmad Samsuri Mokhtar

KUALA TERENGGANU: Datuk Seri Dr Ahmad Samsuri Mokhtar today said that he is still the Menteri Besar (MB) of Terengganu.
“I woke this morning and I am still the Menteri Besar, although there seem to be pictures of 10 menteris besar changing by the hour,” he quipped when met by reporters after visiting the family of Jusoh Muda, 83, who perished in a fire in Kampung Losong Haji Su on Monday.

Ahmad Samsuri said the issue of an impending new MB keenly debated at the moment did not arise.
“People who slander [on the issue of changing the MB] perhaps tend to forget about the fires of hell,” he said.
Last Tuesday, PAS Terengganu lodged a police report against a news portal for its report that implied that Ahmad Samsuri’s position as the MB was hanging in the balance.
His political secretary Muhyiddin Abdul Rashid said the news report was deemed defamatory and malicious and written to tarnish the credibility of the MB’s leadership. -BERNAMA

Pas pusat belum bincang cadangan kerajaan campuran

Oleh Bernama -   13 March 2019 







Datuk Seri Dr. Ahmad Samsuri Mokhtar

KUALA NERUS – Pas Pusat masih belum mengadakan perbincangan mendalam berhubung cadangan UMNO untuk mewujudkan kerajaan campuran di 4 negeri yang ditadbir Barisan Nasional (BN) dan Pas ketika ini.
Pengarah Pilihan Raya, Ahmad Samsuri Mokhtar berkata, sehingga kini belum ada perbincangan khusus mengenai cadangan yang dilontarkan oleh Timbalan Presiden UMNO, Mohamad Hasan.

Beliau berkata, kepimpinan tertinggi Pas dan UMNO sedang mendapatkan reaksi dan maklum balas daripada ahli parti masing-masing mengenai hasrat itu.
“Tetapi pada masa ini tidak ada keputusan lagi…kita masih menunggu maklum balas daripada pemegang taruh sebelum keputusan dibuat,” katanya kepada pemberita selepas program MB Mari Kampung Kite, Siri Jelajah Penerangan Bajet 2019 di Stadium Tertutup Gong Badak hari ini.
“Secara umumnya kita melihat apa jua inisiatif dan usaha ke arah membentuk sebuah kerajaan yang kuat dan inklusif adalah suatu perkara yang akan memberi kepentingan kepada rakyat,” katanya.
Mengenai kesediaan Pas Terengganu untuk memberi laluan kepada wakil BN sebagai exco jika diminta berbuat demikian, beliau berkata, perkara tersebut bergantung kepada bentuk model penyatuan kerajaan.
Justeru, katanya, adalah penting agar satu kajian mendalam dilakukan oleh Pas untuk melihat kesan model penyatuan tersebut kepada kepentingan rakyat sekiranya kerajaan campuran dipersetujui.
“Kita mempunyai banyak model yang sangat unik dan ia memerlukan kajian mendalam untuk melihat bagaimana model negeri yang dibentuk itu nanti memberi kesan kepada rakyat,” katanya. – Bernama

Terengganu bakal benarkan makan dalam kedai, restoran

Oleh Bernama -   29 May 2020 







Datuk Seri Dr. Ahmad Samsuri Mokhtar



KUALA TERENGGANU – Kerajaan negeri Terengganu bakal membenarkan pelanggan makan di dalam kedai atau restoran tidak lama lagi, kata Menteri Besar Datuk Seri Dr Ahmad Samsuri Mokhtar.
Beliau berkata prosedur operasi standard (SOP) berhubung perkara itu sedang dirangka dengan mengambil kira pelbagai aspek, sebelum pengumuman rasmi dibuat dalam masa terdekat.

Justeru, beliau mengingatkan orang ramai supaya mematuhi segala arahan kerajaan bagi memastikan tiada penularan COVID-19 apabila ia dilaksanakan kelak.


“Paling penting adalah persediaan minda dalam kalangan peniaga dan pengunjung. Kebenaran diberi bukan untuk duduk bersembang berjam-jam dengan hanya secawan teh tarik sahaja.
“Adalah sangat penting untuk memastikan keselamatan dan kesihatan semua pihak terjaga. InsyaAllah, kita akan umumkan tarikh (kebenaran) dalam masa terdekat,” kata beliau menerusi laman rasmi Facebook miliknya hari ini.
Sementara itu, rata-rata netizen yang memberi komen di pautan berkenaan menyokong keputusan tersebut bagi membolehkan peniaga memperoleh pendapatan dan ada juga berharap kerajaan negeri membuat pemantauan secara berkala untuk mengelak orang ramai mengabaikan SOP.


Terdapat juga netizen menyuarakan pandangan supaya kerajaan negeri membenarkan lebih banyak masjid dan surau beroperasi, namun menerusi pautan yang sama, Ahmad Samsuri berkata pihaknya masih tidak dapat melaksanakannya atas sebab tertentu.
“Kita akan buat berperingkat mengambil kira nasihat Pejabat Mufti Terengganu, Kementerian Kesihatan dan agensi berkaitan serta perkenan Sultan Terengganu Sultan Mizan Zainal Abidin. Mohon bersabar ya,” katanya dalam pautan tersebut.
— BERNAMA

Terengganu dijangka beralih ke fasa tiga bulan depan – Menteri Besar

Oleh Bernama -   18 August 2021 







Datuk Seri Dr. Ahmad Samsuri Mokhtar

KUALA TERENGGANU – Terengganu dijangka beralih ke Fasa Tiga Pelan Pemulihan Negara (PPN) September ini, kata Menteri Besar, Datuk Seri Dr Ahmad Samsuri Mokhtar.
Kadar vaksinasi dua dos di negeri tersebut kini sudah mencapai kira-kira 35 peratus dan hanya tinggal kurang lima peratus untuk mencapai syarat yang dikenakan bagi beralih ke Fasa Tiga, katanya.

“Untuk Terengganu, penerima satu dos kita sudah capai 60 peratus manakala berdasarkan data dua hari lepas, bagi penerima dua dos kita sudah berada pada 35 peratus. Jadi ada kurang lima peratus lagi sebelum Terengganu sampai ke 40 peratus sebagai salah satu syarat mencapai fasa berikutnya,” katanya.
Beliau berkata demikian kepada pemberita selepas menyempurnakan Majlis Pelancaran Kempen Kibar Jalur Gemilang 2021 di Wisma Darul Iman, di sini hari ini.
Sebelum ini, indikator bagi membolehkan peralihan ke Fasa Tiga, adalah usaha vaksinasi dua dos perlu mencapai kadar 40 peratus, penggunaan Unit Rawatan Rapi (ICU) di tahap selamat, dan kes harian COVID-19 berada di bawah angka 2,000.
Dalam pada itu beliau berkata, kerajaan negeri sentiasa berunding dengan Pasukan Petugas Khas Imunisasi COVID-19 (CITF) Kebangsaan supaya Terengganu menerima tambahan jumlah vaksin COVID-19, memandangkan terdapat kes positif di negeri ini melibatkan varian Delta atau varian mutasi berganda dari India. – Bernama

MB, Exco Terengganu potong separuh bulan gaji untuk Tabung Covid-19

Oleh Manzaidi Mohd Amin -   28 March 2020 







Datuk Seri Dr. Ahmad Samsuri Mokhtar

KUALA LUMPUR – Menteri Besar dan semua anggota Exco Kerajaan Terengganu memotong separuh bulan gaji untuk Tabung Bantuan Covid-19.
Pemotongan selama dua bulan itu akan diisi dalam Tabung Covid-19 Terengganu yang turut dibuka kepada pelbagai pihak untuk menderma.

Datuk Seri Dr. Ahmad Samsuri Mokhtar ketika melancarkan tabung itu berkata, sebagai sumbangan permulaan, beliau bersama anggota Exconya akan membuat pemotongan 50 peratus dari dua bulan gaji untuk dimasukkan dalam tabung itu.
“Tabung ini turut dibuka kepada semua rakyat yang prihatin, penderma korporat dan syarikat swasta untuk membantu golongan yang terjejas akibat wabak pandemik ini di Terengganu,” kata Menteri Besar itu dalam kenyataannya kepada media, hari ini.
Menurut Dr. Ahmad Samsuri, inisiatif itu diambil dengan menyedari tempoh Peraturan Kawalan Pergerakan (PKP) yang dilanjutkan memberi impak lebih besar kepada sosio-ekonomi rakyat negeri itu.
Beliau merayu dan berbesar hati supaya semua pihak dapat memberikan sumbangan bagi menunjukkan semangat kesatuan dan kecaknaan bersama.
Katanya, sumbangan boleh disalurkan melalui akaun Bank Islam Malaysia Berhad bernombor 13017010034566 atas nama Tetuan Akauntan Negeri Terengganu.
“Setiap sumbangan layak mendapat potongan cukai dengan mengikut tatacara garis panduan yang dikeluarkan oleh Lembaga Hasil Dalam Negeri (LHDN).
Sebarang persoalan boleh hubungi Sekretariat Tabung Darul Iman di talian 09-6233535 atau layari http://stdi.terengganu.gov.my. – MalaysiaGazette

Covid-19: Terengganu umum Pakej Rangsangan Cakna Fasa 3

Oleh Manzaidi Mohd Amin -   25 March 2020 







Datuk Seri Dr. Ahmad Samsuri Mokhtar

KUALA LUMPUR – Kerajaan Terengganu mengumumkan tambahan peruntukan bantuan barangan keperluan harian berjumlah RM960,000 di bawah Pakej Rangsangan Terengganu Cakna Fasa Tiga.
Menteri Besarnya, Datuk Seri Dr. Ahmad Samsuri Mokhtar ketika mengumumkan perkara itu berkata, tambahan peruntukan itu adalah bagi menangani kesan penularan wabak Covid-19 kepada golongan terjejas.

“Pakej ini adalah tambahan kepada Pakej Rangsangan Terengganu Cakna Fasa Satu dengan peruntukan sejumlah RM640,000 serta Fasa Dua yang melibatkan beberapa program penangguhan dan pengecualian bayaran,” katanya dalam kenyataan kepada media, hari ini.
Dr. Ahmad Samsuri berkata, peruntukan tambahan itu melibatkan RM30,000 di setiap Dewan Undangan Negeri (DUN) untuk 600 keluarga terjejas akan dikenal pasti oleh Pusat Khidmat Masyarakat dan Majlis Pengurusan Komuniti Kampung (MPKK).
Kata beliau, keutamaan adalah kepada keluarga yang tiada gaji tetap serta tiada bantuan bulanan daripada Jabatan Kebajikan Masyarakat dan Majlis Agama Islam dan Adat Melayu Terengganu (MAIDAM).
“Bantuan segera ini diberikan hanya kepada rakyat yang amat memerlukan berupa pakej barangan keperluan makanan harian seperti beras, sardin dan seumpamanya bagi setiap keluarga.
“Kerajaan negeri juga akan menyelaras pakej bantuan kepada rakyat akibat wabak Covid-19 melalui beberapa fasa yang akan diumumkan dari semasa ke semasa.
“Bersama kita berdoa supaya negara segera pulih dari wabak ini seperti sedia kala,” katanya. – MalaysiaGazette

Nasional

Terengganu pertimbang beli kepentingan Petronas jika ekuiti munasabah

Oleh Bernama -   11 December 2019 







Datuk Seri Dr. Ahmad Samsuri Mokhtar

KUALA TERENGGANU – Kerajaan negeri akan mempertimbangkan untuk membeli kepentingan dalam Petroliam Nasional Bhd (Petronas) sekiranya ia dijual dalam bentuk ekuiti yang munasabah.
Menteri Besar, Datuk Seri Dr Ahmad Samsuri Mokhtar berkata, ini berikutan kerajaan negeri tidak mempunyai kemampuan dari segi kewangan untuk memiliki keseluruhan pegangan dalam syarikat minyak nasional itu.

“Apa pun bergantung kepada aset-aset berkenaan iaitu telaga minyak. Saiz, harganya berapa dan sebagainya. Kalau sampai berbilion-bilion itu tidak mampu juga kita (kerajaan negeri). Negeri-negeri seperti Sabah dan Sarawak mempunyai simpanan tunai yang besar berbanding Terengganu.
“Tetapi kalau dalam bentuk ekuiti, (contohnya) lima atau 10 peratus itu mungkin boleh dipertimbangkan. Di Terengganu kita ada banyak telaga minyak. Katalah satu-satu telaga minyak itu sekadar harga RM10 juta atau RM20 juta, kita boleh beli,” katanya kepada pemberita selepas mempengerusikan mesyuarat Exco di Wisma Darul Iman di sini hari ini.
Semalam, Perdana Menteri Tun Dr Mahathir Mohamad dilapor berkata, kerajaan sedang mempertimbang untuk menjual saham dalam Petronas kepada negeri-negeri yang mempunyai loji syarikat minyak dan gas itu.
Dr Mahathir berkata, cadangan itu dibuat dalam usaha mencari dana bagi kerajaan yang kini dibebani oleh hutang yang tinggi.
Bagaimanapun, Ahmad Samsuri berkata, kerajaan negeri setakat ini belum dimaklumkan secara rasmi mengenai cadangan itu dan akan mendapatkan maklumat terperinci sebelum membuat sebarang keputusan.
Dalam pada itu beliau memaklumkan, Terengganu setakat ini kekal menerima lima peratus bayaran royalti minyak dari Kerajaan Persekutuan dan belum membuat sebarang tuntutan untuk menaikkan bayaran tersebut kepada 20 peratus seperti dilakukan Sabah dan Sarawak. – Bernama

Lebih 100 maut dalam kejadian tanah runtuh di Bangladesh

Oleh Agensi -   14 June 2017 







Pasukan penyelamat sedang mencari mangsa-mangsa yang tertimbus akibat tanah runtuh di Chittagong, Bangladesh. foto Agensi

DHAKA – Hujan lebat telah mengakibatkan tanah runtuh di tenggara Bangladesh, mengorbankan sekurang-kurangnya 107 orang termasuk lima anggota tentera.
Jurucakap pentadbiran daerah Rangamati berkata, sekurang-kurangnya 60 orang terbunuh dalam kejadian tanah runtuh di kawasan itu.

Operasi menyelamat sukar dilakukan kerana cuaca buruk.
Jaringan telekomunikasi dan elektrik telah terputus dan sesetengah penduduk tidak dapat dihubungi.
“Kami belum dapat mencapai banyak tempat-tempat yang terjejas.
“Kita akan hanya dapat gambaran jelas tentang kerosakan apabila musim hujan berakhir,” Reaz Ahmed, ketua Jabatan Pengurusan Bencana.
Daerah Rangamati adalah kawasan berbukit yang hampir dengan sempadan India.
Menurut Ketua Polis daerah itu, Sayed Tariqul Hasan, kejadian tanah runtuh telah menimbus banyak penduduk yang sedang tidur.
Tentera yang terbunuh itu sedang membersihkan jalan raya di Rangamati akibat tanah runtuh sebelumnya apabila kejadian sama berlaku lagi.
Lalu lintas di ibu negara Dhaka dan Chittagong, bandar pelabuhan utama Bangladesh itu, juga terganggu disebabkan hujan lebat.
Bulan lalu, sekurang-kurangnya lapan orang terbunuh dan beribu-ribu rumah musnah selepas Cyclone Mora melanda tenggara Bangladesh.
Sehingga satu juta orang telah dipindahkan. – MalaysiaGazette

Oleh Agensi -   24 June 2017 







Pasukan penyelamat sedang mencari mangsa yang terperangkap selepas kejadian tanah runtuh di Sichuan . foto Agensi

BEIJING – Lebih 100 orang dipercayai terperangkap dalam kejadian tanah runtuh di wilayah Sichuan di barat daya China, kata media negara.
Kira-kira 40 buah rumah musnah di Kampung Xinmo di daerah Maoxian, selepas sebahagian gunung runtuh kira-kira jam 6 pagi waktu tempatan (22:00 GMT Jumaat).

Operasi penyelamatan kini sedang dijalankan untuk mencari dan menyelamatkan mangsa yang hilang.
Gambar yang disiarkan oleh akhbar harian People’s Bulls menunjukkan jentolak bergerak ke bumi dan batu-batu besar sebagai usaha menyelamat secara berterusan.
Tanah runtuh merupakan ancaman kepada penduduk yang tinggal di kawasan pergunungan di China terutama musim hujan. – MalaysiaGazette

Nasional

Paip bawah tanah bocor punca tanah runtuh di Taman Mega Jaya

Oleh Bernama -   2 December 2022 







Keadaan tanah runtuh di Taman Mega Jaya, Ampamg.
Foto Jabatan Bomba & Penyelamat Malaysia


KUALA LUMPUR, 2 Dis (Bernama) — Tanah runtuh pada anggaran ketinggian 30 meter (m) berlaku di kawasan perumahan di Taman Mega Jaya, Ampang, di sini hari ini dipercayai akibat kebocoran paip air bawah tanah.
Pengarah Jabatan Bomba dan Penyelamat Malaysia (JBPM) Selangor Norazam Khamis berkata pihaknya menerima panggilan berhubung kejadian itu pada 2.48 petang tadi sebelum tujuh anggota dari Balai Bomba dan Penyelamat Pandan tiba di lokasi 12 minit kemudian.

“Bagaimanapun kejadian itu tidak melibatkan sebarang mangsa atau struktur rumah. Rumah yang paling hampir dengan lokasi runtuhan adalah kira-kira 20m,” katanya dalam kenyataan hari ini.





Menurutnya ketika ini, pemantauan masih diteruskan pihak bomba dan kerja-kerja penyelenggaraan sedang dilakukan Indah Water Konsortium. – BERNAMA

45 terbunuh, bas terhumban dalam tanah runtuh

Oleh Agensi -   14 August 2017 



Anggota tentera terlibat dalam operasi dan mencari penumpang-penumpang bas yang hilang selepas kenderaan yang mereka naiki terhumban dalam tanah runtuh. foto Agensi
DELHI – Sekurang-kurangnya 45 orang penumpang terbunuh apabila dua bas terhumban akibat berlaku tanah runtuh di utara India.
Kejadian itu berlaku semasa bas-bas berkenaan berhenti berehat di kawasan berkenaan ketika hujan lebat melanda di daerah Mandi, dekat Himachal Pradesh.

Tentera telah menyertai usaha pencarian. Lima orang telah diselamatkan dengan kecederaan parah, kata laporan.
Pasukan tentera telah dikerahkan untuk operasi dan menyelamat. Lima penumpang telah diselamatkan dengan kecederaan parah.
Jumlah kematian dijangka meningkat kerana ramai yang masih hilang.
Tanah runtuh biasa berlaku di India terutama pada musim tengkujuh dari bulan Julai hingga September.
Jalan raya, kira-kira 200 kilometer (124 batu) dari ibu negara Shimla, telah dibersihkan sepenuhnya.
Beberapa rumah dan kenderaan lain juga dimusnahkan.
Hujan lebat telah menjejaskan jutaan penduduk di 20 buah negeri di India. – MalaysiaGazette

Tanah runtuh, sekurang-kurangnya 20 mangsa hilang di Jepun

Oleh Agensi -   3 July 2021 







Sekurang-kurangnya 20 orang hilang dan dua mayat ditemui selepas kejadian tanah runtuh besar di sebuah bandar peranginan di Jepun hari ini.-Gambar FB

TOKYO – Sekurang-kurangnya 20 orang hilang dan dua mayat ditemui selepas kejadian tanah runtuh besar di sebuah bandar peranginan di Jepun hari ini.
Berpuluh-puluh rumah mungkin ‘terkubur’ setelah arus lumpur melanda lereng bukit di daerah Izusan, Atami, barat daya Tokyo sekitar pukul 10 pagi selepas beberapa hari hujan lebat.

Rakaman video yang mengejutkan menunjukkan tanah runtuh runtuh di lereng bukit dan menghancurkan bangunan menyebabkan orang melarikan diri.
Menurut laporan DailyMail, dua orang ditemui dalam keadaan serangan jantung dan masalah pernafasan’, kata gabenor wilayah itu.
Gabenor Shizuoka mendakwa sekitar 20 orang masih hilang setelah dihanyutkan oleh tanah runtuh sementara askar telah bergabung dengan pasukan bomba dan polis dalam operasi mencari dan menyelamat mangsa-mangsa terperangkap di bawah lumpur.- MalaysiaGazette

210 locations affected by flood in 6 states – NADMA

Oleh Admin -   22 December 2021 







The aerial view of Hulu Langat, Selangor during the flood following the continuous heavy downpour.
PIX: AFFAN FAUZI / MalaysiaGazette / 21 DECEMBER 2021
Pemandangan udara kawasan yang dilanda banjir akibat hujan berterusan ketika tinjauan lensa Malaysia Gazette di Hulu Langat, Selangor. Foto AFFAN FAUZI, 21 DISEMBER 2021.

KUALA LUMPUR: 210 locations in six states namely Selangor, Negeri Sembilan, Terengganu, Kelantan, Pahang and Kedah are still affected by floods as at 10.00 am today.
The National Disaster Management Agency (NADMA) Disaster Operation Control Centre said in a statement today that the locations involved eight districts in Selangor, Negeri Sembilan (three), Terengganu (two), Kelantan (three), Pahang (eight) and Kedah (three).

Among the locations affected by floods are Bera, Jerantut, Maran, Raub, Pekan, Temerloh, in Pahang and Kuala Selangor, Kuala Langat, Hulu Langat in Selangor.
83 federal roads and 126 state roads were also affected by flash floods, landslides, road collapse, sinkholes and damaged bridges.







“Some routes are still closed to all traffic while some are open to heavy vehicles,” NADMA said in the statement.
Among the roads opened to heavy vehicles are Jalan Seri Keledang, Hulu Selangor; Jalan Banting-Semenyih; Jalan Lubok Kiat-Kubang Kuau, Pasir Mas; Jalan Kampung Paya Petai-Sungai Salan, Jerantut; Jalan Bukit Rangin 3, Kuantan and Jalan Serengkam, Maran.
16 routes have been reopened to all traffic, among them are Jalan Benta-Lamir, Jalan Pekan-Batu Balik; Pekan as well as Jalan Air Putih, Kemaman.
Meanwhile, the water level at several rivers in Selangor, Pahang and Kelantan recorded danger level as of 7am based on the Department of Irrigation and Drainage’s Infobanjir portal.
According to Infobanjir, the danger level was recorded at Sungai Langat in Bukit Changgang, Kuala Langat; Sungai Kuang in Kampung Melayu Seri Kundang, Gombak; Sungai Rasau in Tugu Keris, Klang; Sungai Pahang in Paya Gintong, Jerantut; Sungai Pahang in Kuala Krau, Temerloh and Sungai Pahang in Temerloh (Lubuk Pasu), Temerloh.
Other rivers are Sungai Pahang at the Water Front, Bera; Sungai Bera at Sungai Bera Bridge, Bera; Sungai Jengka at Kampung Awah Bridge, Maran; Sungai Pahang in Lubuk Paku, Maran; Sungai Pahang in Kuala Sungai Chini, Pekan; Sungai Kuantan in Pasir Kemudi, Kuantan and Sungai Golok in Rantau Panjang, Pasir Mas. – BERNAMA

PBB perlu bantuan segera untuk Rohingya

10 September 2017 0 

 Dunia 

BANGLADESH - Pertubuhan Bangsa-Bangsa Bersatu (PBB) memerlukan bantuan segera berjumlah AS$77 juta bagi membantu penduduk Islam Rohingya yang melarikan diri ke Bangladesh sejak keganasan meletus dua minggu lalu.
Kira-kira 290,000 Rohingya dikatakan telah melarikan diri dari negeri Rakhine dan mencari perlindungan di Bangladesh sejak 25 Ogos.
Terdapat keperluan terdesak untuk makanan, air dan perkhidmatan kesihatan untuk pelarian yang baru tiba di Bazaar Cox, tambah PBB.
Pelarian yang melarikan diri mendakwa kediaman di kampung-kampung mereka telah dibakar oleh tentera Myanmar.
Keganasan bermula pada 25 Ogos lalu apabila pemberontak Rohingya menyerang polis di negeri utara Rakhine Myanmar.
Penduduk Rohingya - minoritinya tanpa kerakyatan dan beragama Islam.
Bagaimanapun, Myanmar menolak dakwaan keganasan yang didakwa penduduk Rohingya tetapi menyatakan tenteranya memerangi 'pengganas' Rohingya
Agensi bantuan di Bazaar Cox Bangladesh memaklumkan jumlah yang melarikan diri berjumlah beribu-ribu orang.
